gripOrHq.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

gripOrHq.title: Hammer
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Romp through HQ
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Desperate Competitor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you liberated any Gray Ops agendas this turn. Score 1 agenda point.

heapOrArchives.title: Custodial Position
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Hot Tip for WNS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Score 1 agenda point if you liberated any Black Ops agendas this turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Terrorist Reprisal
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if the Corp scored any Black Ops agendas during its last turn. The Corp discards five cards at random.

heapOrArchives.title: Private LDL Access
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

root.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
root.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.
